={{ `You are checking whether Wikimedia Commons or Openverse images show the requested subjects for a multi-slide story.

Story context: ${$('Get Next Story').first().json.Title}

Slides and their candidate pools (JSON array; use pageid to refer to candidates):
${JSON.stringify($json.compactSlides)}

For EACH slide, choose the single candidate that best shows the requested subject: the object/scene/hardware/specimen itself, recognisable, well-lit, and not an unrelated object. Reject photos where unrelated seasonal window displays, flowers, storefront reflections, or crowds obscure the subject. Avoid picking the same pageid for two different slides when another valid candidate exists. Person-led images are allowed if relevant. Reject unrelated diagrams or clipart, unless the subject itself is an interface screen, typography specimen, historical map/chart, or blueprint.

IMPORTANT — AVOID AI FALLBACKS WHEN REAL PHOTOS EXIST: Strongly prefer selecting a real Wikimedia Commons or Openverse museum/archival photograph (such as a different surviving fragment, rear view, close-up, or museum exhibition replica of the story's primary artifact/hardware) whenever any candidate genuinely depicts the story's primary subject, rather than returning null and forcing an AI-generated image. On Slide 1 (cover) and the final slide, do NOT select a generic building exterior or unrelated café/street interior when the primary artifact itself is not clearly shown. If the candidate is a modern replica or model, mention "(modern replica)" in your reason.

Rate confidence per slide:
- high: title or description clearly identifies the requested subject or a genuine museum view/fragment of the story's artifact.
- medium: plausibly the subject or a museum reconstruction/model of the artifact.
- low: unrelated, wrong artifact, or cannot tell.

If none match for a slide, return chosen_pageid null with confidence low.

Return ONLY JSON: {"choices": [{"slide_index": 1, "chosen_pageid": 123 or null, "confidence": "high|medium|low", "reason": "one sentence"}]}` }}

parameters.jsCode:
const s=$input.first().json;const choices=$('Collect Choices').all().map(x=>x.json);const bad=choices.filter(c=>!['selected','text_only'].includes(c.result));const flags=(s.Flags||'').split(';').map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);if(bad.length&&!flags.includes('image needs review'))flags.push('image needs review');const log='WF3c '+new Date().toISOString()+'
'+choices.map(c=>'Slide '+c.slide_index+': '+c.subject+' — '+c.result+' ('+c.confidence+'): '+c.reason).join('
');return [{json:{id:s.id,Flags:flags.join('; '),'Reviewer Notes':(s['Reviewer Notes']?s['Reviewer Notes']+'

':'')+log}}];

return $('Collect Choices').all().filter(x=>x.json.result==='selected'||x.json.result==='needs_review'||(!x.json.chosen&&x.json.aiFallbackPrompt&&x.json.result!=='text_only')).map((x,i)=>({json:x.json,pairedItem:{item:0}}));

const out=[];for(const [i,x]of $input.all().entries()){const m=$('Needs AI Generation?').itemMatching(i).json;const b=await this.helpers.getBinaryDataBuffer(i,'data');if(!/^image\//.test(x.binary?.data?.mimeType||'')||b.length<=10240||!(b[0]===0xff&&b[1]===0xd8)&&!(b[0]===0x89&&b[1]===0x50)&&!(b.toString('ascii',0,4)==='RIFF')&&!(b.toString('ascii',0,2)==='II')&&!(b.toString('ascii',0,2)==='MM'))throw new Error('Download verification failed for slide '+m.slide_index+': '+(x.binary?.data?.mimeType||'missing MIME')+', '+b.length+' bytes');out.push({json:{...m,localPath:$env.WE_HUMANITY_ROOT + '/assets/' +$('Get Next Story').first().json.id+'_slide_'+m.slide_index+'.'+(x.binary.data.fileExtension||'jpg')},binary:x.binary,pairedItem:{item:i}});}return out;
return $input.all().map((x,i)=>({json:{...x.json,chosen:null,confidence:'low',reason:'No licensed matching image candidates were found.',result:'no_candidates'},pairedItem:{item:i}}));
return $input.all().map((x,i)=>({json:{...$('Capture Image Failure').itemMatching(i).json,imageFailed:true},pairedItem:{item:i}}));
return $input.all().flatMap((x,i)=>!x.json.imageFailed&&x.binary?.data?[{json:x.json,binary:x.binary,pairedItem:{item:i}}]:[]);
return [{ json: { storyId: $('Get Next Story').first().json.id, uploadedCount: $input.all().length } }];
return [{ json: { storyId: $('Get Next Story').first().json.id, skippedExistingAssets: true } }];
